skillset.skill: 12s CT- 2200% Earth DMG (PHY). Plant 3 bombs (up to 6).
skillset.arts: 16000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase Allies' evasion by [5% × # of bombs planted].
skillset.truearts: For 120s, enter Third Eye. During Third Eye: [40000% + 10000% × # of bombs planted] Earth DMG (PHY). Remove all planted bombs. For 15s, increase Allies' PHY DMG by 100%.

passive.ability1: During Third Eye or True Third Eye, ignore 100% of Enemies' DEF and increase Arts by 5/s.
passive.ability2: When entering Third Eye or True Third Eye, if enemy boss is God/Spirit, activate True Third Eye instead. During True Third Eye, increase DMG to God and Spirit enemies by 200%.

trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 7500% Earth DMG (PHY). For 10s, increase own DMG by 50% and reduce Enemies' Earth RES by 30%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Sakuya, increase Skill CT REC by 30% and increase max # of possible planted bombs by 1. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
